title: PPG-MS17 — Cross-Simulator Live Verification (Fusion Verify + Vericut/NCSIMUL + ensemble 3-tier verdict)
description: Adds the missing live-verify round-trip — pushes PRISM-emitted programs into the host CAM simulator (Fusion Verify today; hyperMILL hyperVIEW + Mastercam Verify next), runs Vericut/NCSIMUL as the gold-standard tier, and aggregates all three verdicts (PRISM physics + host geometric + Vericut controller-accurate) into one ensemble decision shown in the wizard. Closes the gap between PRISM's internal cnc_simulate_physics (Tier A) and what shop programmers actually trust to send to the machine.
rationale: User asked: can we live-test programs with our posts inside Fusion? Fusion's Verify is excellent for geometric checks (collision, gouge, axis-limit, kinematics) but doesn't catch physics violations (chatter, deflection, force) and uses generic controller models that don't simulate Hurco UltiMotion G05.3 / Okuma G131 / Mitsubishi M800 dialect quirks. PRISM's cnc_simulate_physics is the inverse — physics-aware but not controller-accurate. Vericut/NCSIMUL fill the controller-accuracy gap. Ensemble of all three is the only honest verdict. Existing actions exist (cnc_simulate*, vericut_export, ncsimul_export, f360_live_*) but no PPG-MS owns wiring them into a single live-test flow.
leverage_existing: cnc_simulate / cnc_simulate_report / cnc_simulate_physics / cnc_simulate_predictive — Tier A PRISM physics simulator (already wired)

f360_live_* family (14 actions: sketch, extrude, fillet, chamfer, revolve, hole, pattern, combine, shell, export, geometry, undo, new_doc, execute_raw) — Fusion 360 Live API for CAD construction, extend with verify
vericut_export + vericut_import_optipath + vericut_import_collision — Vericut I/O actions (already wired, untested round-trip)
ncsimul_export + ncsimul_import — NCSIMUL I/O actions (already wired, untested round-trip)
cam_addin_generate + cam_addin_http_client + cam_addin_ui_panel + cam_addin_post_integration — Fusion Add-In scaffold for verify bridge
PostProcessorPipelineEngine — emit chain feeds the ensemble verifier as a final stage
OmegaSafetyScoreEngine + omega-thresholds.json (PPG-MS8) — tier-aware HARD BLOCK on disagreement
WEDMRunPipelineEngine + wedm_run_pipeline + wedm_studio_pipeline + wedm_advanced_analysis + wedm_generate_complete_program — WEDM-native verifier substrate
WEDMSafetyGateEngine — emit-time gates that double as a verifier when run on existing programs
Custom WEDM simulation: WEDMSparkErosionEngine + WEDMGapVoltageEngine + WEDMMRREngine — physics-accurate simulation (Vericut does NOT cover WEDM)

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Programmer at JM Die generates a Hurco V11 D2 die plate program through the wizard. Block 47 has a corner where PRISM's per-block force estimates 2,600 N (over the 2,500 N machine ceiling).
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms17: Fusion's Verify shows clean (geometry is fine, no collision). PRISM's cnc_simulate_physics flags the force violation. Programmer doesn't trust PRISM ("the simulator says it's fine") and runs the program. Spindle stalls. $80 endmill chips.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms17: Wizard runs all three tiers: (A) PRISM physics → BLOCK on force ceiling at block 47; (B) Fusion Verify → CLEAN; (C) Vericut → CLEAN with predicted cycle-time. Ensemble panel shows all three verdicts side-by-side with the disagreement flagged: 'Tier A blocks on physics; Tiers B+C clean on geometry. Override at shop_floor requires explicit physics-violation acceptance.' Programmer sees the WHY and accepts the auto-fix from PPG-MS14 (derate Vc 15%). All three tiers re-run; all three pass; emit proceeds.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Programmers see ALL the truth, not just one perspective. Disagreement between simulators is surfaced, not hidden.

units.title: CamSimulatorAdapter interface + Fusion 360 Add-In Verify implementation
units.scope: src/engines/CamSimulatorAdapterEngine.ts — abstract interface (loadProgram, runVerify, getVerdict, getCollisionReport, getCycleTime). Fusion implementation pushes .cps + sidecar to running Fusion via Add-In HTTP bridge (cam_addin_http_client); auto-launches Fusion if not running; reads Verify result JSON back. Live in-host, not file-based.

units.title: Vericut round-trip adapter wiring
units.scope: src/engines/VericutAdapterEngine.ts — extends existing vericut_export action; runs Vericut headless via subprocess (where licensed); parses VERICUT XML reports; ingests collision + axis-travel + cycle-time verdict via vericut_import_collision + vericut_import_optipath. Tier C / gold-standard.

units.title: NCSIMUL adapter wiring
units.scope: src/engines/NCSimulAdapterEngine.ts — parallel to Vericut adapter but for NCSIMUL; uses ncsimul_export + ncsimul_import. Selectable per-shop (shop preference stored in ShopConfigurationEngine).

units.title: hyperMILL hyperVIEW + Mastercam Verify adapter stubs (expansion hooks)
units.scope: src/engines/HyperMillHyperViewAdapterEngine.ts + src/engines/MastercamVerifyAdapterEngine.ts — adapter shape + interface only. Loads programs via host-specific path; placeholder verdict (PASS-WITH-WARNING) until the user expands to hyperMILL/Mastercam. Implements CamSimulatorAdapter interface so EnsembleVerdictAggregator can plug them in transparently.

units.title: EnsembleVerdictAggregatorEngine (combines Tier A + B + C, flags disagreement)
units.scope: src/engines/EnsembleVerdictAggregatorEngine.ts — runs all configured tiers in parallel; aggregates verdicts; computes ENSEMBLE = worst-of-three for HARD BLOCK on shop_floor; flags disagreements (Tier A says BLOCK, Tier B says CLEAN) as explicit reconciliation entries; tier-aware via omega-thresholds.json.

units.title: Wizard 3-tier verdict UI (all tiers visible, disagreement explainer, one-click rerun-tier)
units.scope: web/src/components/ppg/EnsembleVerdictPanel.tsx — three columns (PRISM physics / Fusion Verify / Vericut), per-column verdict (PASS/WARN/BLOCK) + summary, disagreement banner with explainer, per-tier rerun button. Wired into PostProcessorGeneratorPage step 4.

units.title: End-to-end ensemble verify on D2 reference part (3-tier round-trip)
units.scope: src/__tests__/EnsembleVerify.e2e.integration.test.ts — runs the D2 die plate reference job through all three tiers; asserts ensemble verdict matches expected (Tier A force-block + Tier B clean + Tier C clean → ENSEMBLE BLOCK on shop_floor); validates wizard banner copy; validates rerun-tier flow.

units.title: Cross-CAM forward feature emission expansion (Mastercam Dynamic Motion / hyperMILL Maxx / SolidCAM iMachining / PowerMill Vortex → post emit)
units.scope: Closes PP-REV-MS5 cross-CAM feature-injection orphan. Extends MS17 hyperMILL/Mastercam adapter stubs from VERIFY-only to BIDIRECTIONAL: ingests proprietary CAM features (Mastercam Dynamic Motion / OptiRough; hyperMILL Maxx Machining / 5X Tangent; SolidCAM iMachining; PowerMill Vortex / Steep & Shallow) and emits dialect-correct G-code into the post pipeline. Per-CAM CamFeatureAdapter interface; each adapter declares supported features + emission strategy. Backward telemetry ingest stubbed (CAM run-stats → PPG calibration) for future MS11 wiring.

units.title: WEDM verifier path (no Vericut substitute — uses native WEDM physics simulation)
units.scope: src/engines/WEDMVerifyAdapterEngine.ts — implements CamSimulatorAdapter interface but routes to WEDM-native physics simulation (WEDMRunPipelineEngine + wedm_safety_gate_evaluate + wedm_predict_wire_break + wedm_assess_surface_integrity + wedm_kerf_overcut + wedm_thermal_release_evaluate); produces same verdict structure as Fusion/Vericut adapters so EnsembleVerdictAggregator treats it transparently. Vericut/NCSIMUL do not support WEDM dialects (Mitsubishi M800 / Sodick / AgieCharmilles WEDM-specific) — PRISM owns this gap. WEDM reference job corpus ≥3: (1) MV1200R 5-pass D2 12mm 4° taper (canonical); (2) Sodick AQ325L 4-pass H13 8mm straight; (3) AgieCharmilles CUT 1000 micro-EDM 6mm carbide with 0.25R corners. Adversarial: (a) program references undefined wire diameter → reject; (b) flush pressure 0 in sidecar → predict wire-break >50% and HARD BLOCK on shop_floor. HAZ verifier (S05): native physics simulation routes wedm_haz_predict + wedm_haz_stock_allowance + wedm_assess_surface_integrity to verify HAZ ≤spec at verify time (closes the gap that HAZ was leveraged in MS3 only, not gated at emit OR verify).

units.title: Lathe verifier path (Fusion 360 lathe + Vericut + native lathe physics)
units.scope: src/engines/LatheVerifyAdapterEngine.ts — Fusion 360 has lathe verify (different from mill verify); Vericut supports lathe controllers (Okuma OSP, Fanuc lathe); add native lathe physics fallback (LatheCollisionCheckEngine + LatheSwingCheckEngine + LatheChatterAnalysisEngine) for offline verification. Lathe reference job corpus ≥3: (1) Okuma B250IIW OD turning + boring + threading 4140 (canonical); (2) Multus B250IIW mill-turn 304SS with live tooling + sub-spindle handoff; (3) Hardinge GS 200 hard-turn D2 62HRC. Adversarial: (a) program references chuck force exceeding clamp limit → reject; (b) G76 thread schedule with Vc > tool-life-cliff → predict tool failure and HARD BLOCK.

completion_criteria: Fusion Verify Adapter can push a PRISM-emitted program to a running Fusion 360 instance via Add-In HTTP, trigger Verify, and ingest the result without operator manual steps
Vericut + NCSIMUL adapters round-trip a program and ingest collision + axis-travel + cycle-time verdicts (gated by license availability)
hyperMILL + Mastercam adapter stubs implement CamSimulatorAdapter cleanly so future expansion is a drop-in
EnsembleVerdictAggregator surfaces disagreement explicitly: any 2-of-3 verdicts diverging triggers a reconciliation banner
Wizard 3-tier verdict panel readable + actionable: programmer can identify which tier blocks and rerun individual tiers in <30s
End-to-end ensemble verify test passes on D2 reference part through all three tiers
WEDM verifier path uses native physics simulation; ensemble verdict passes Mitsubishi MV1200R 5-pass D2 reference
Lathe verifier path uses Fusion 360 lathe verify + Vericut + native lathe physics; ensemble verdict passes Okuma B250 OD turning reference
